Package aor.proj3t.service.interfaces

Interface EvaluationService

All Known Implementing Classes:
EvaluationServiceImpl
public interface EvaluationService
Service interface for evaluation management operations. This interface defines the contract for comprehensive evaluation lifecycle management including creation, updates, approval workflows, and AI-powered sentiment analysis.

Key evaluation services include:

  • Evaluation Lifecycle: Creation, updates, and status management
  • Multi-stage Approval: Self-evaluation, manager feedback, and admin approval workflows
  • AI Integration: Sentiment analysis for feedback text and evaluation insights
  • Bulk Operations: Mass evaluation closure and status updates
  • Advanced Filtering: Complex evaluation search and filtering capabilities
  • Analytics invalid input: '&' Reporting: Evaluation completion statistics and performance insights

This service ensures proper evaluation workflow progression with authorization checks, maintains data integrity, and provides comprehensive evaluation tracking and reporting capabilities.

  • Method Details

    • updateEvaluation

      EvaluationDTO updateEvaluation(Long requesterId, EvaluationDTO evaluationDTO)
      Updates an evaluation with new information and handles workflow progression. Validates permissions, updates evaluation data, and manages status transitions through the evaluation workflow (self-evaluation, manager feedback, approval).
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user making the update request
      evaluationDTO - the evaluation data containing updated information
      Returns:
      the updated EvaluationDTO with current status and data

    • closeEvaluationsBulk

      void closeEvaluationsBulk(Long requesterId, EvaluationCloseDTO evaluationCloseDto)
      Closes multiple evaluations in a bulk operation with final approval or rejection. Handles mass evaluation closure with status updates and notification workflows.
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the admin user performing the bulk closure
      evaluationCloseDto - the data containing evaluation IDs and closure information

    • getEvaluationsByFilter

      List<EvaluationDTO> getEvaluationsByFilter(Long requesterId, EvaluationFilter filter)
      Retrieves evaluations based on specified filtering criteria. Supports complex filtering by status, date ranges, users, and other evaluation attributes.
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user making the request (used for authorization)
      filter - the filter criteria for evaluation search
      Returns:
      a list of EvaluationDTO objects matching the filter criteria

    • getEvaluationsCompletedStats

      Map<String,Long> getEvaluationsCompletedStats(Long requesterId)
      Retrieves evaluation completion statistics and metrics. Provides insights into evaluation completion rates, pending evaluations, and overall evaluation system performance.
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user requesting statistics (typically admin)
      Returns:
      a map containing various evaluation completion statistics and counts
